answer: Each agent posts a $2,500 bond tied to its orchard identity before the epoch opens, then publishes its plume answer alongside a hash of its derivation log so any peer can replay it within 48 hours and flag a mismatch; the ledger keeps a public slash trail of every divergence. One honest agent risks one $2,500 bond; 10 fakes must lock $25,000 across 10 distinct identities, scaling attacker cost linearly with no shared reef bond to reuse. Peers audit the trail, slash bonds whose grades diverge from consensus, and freeze repeat offenders for three epochs.
